name: Pure My Imouto Milk Purun♪
original_name: Pure My 妹ミルクぷるん♪
source:
Reiya is a university student. One day, three girls suddenly come to his place. According to them, his grandfather sends them and he needs to choose one girl to marry. He doesn't know what to do at first, but he gradually becomes close with them. However, he finds out a surprising fact that they all have a dick...

[From ErogeShop]
